title: Long-term clinical outcomes after Descemet Membrane Endothelial Keratoplasty (DMEK) in Irido-Corneal Endothelial Syndrome

license.statement: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (article <license>: http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/); not CC BY or CC0, so the record is private

indication: Corneal decompensation in iridocorneal endothelial (ICE) syndrome; 2 phakic eyes (one with cataract, DMEK combined with phacoemulsification and IOL) and 2 pseudophakic eyes

groups.description: DMEK with grafts from Sankara Eye Bank (organ culture in Cornisol, donors above 50 years), surgeon-prepared in the operating room with a single-pull technique, self-made injector, full air fill for one hour; one eye combined with phacoemulsification; 4 eyes of 4 patients

series.baseline_label: Donor ecd preop (Table 2) = donor ECD before DMEK; grafts from Sankara Eye Bank (organ culture), who counted the donor ECD is not stated
series.notes: Table 2 'Case 1' row R3: columns Donor ecd preop (C2) and ECD at 6 M (C3), 12 M (C5), 24 M (C7), 36 M (C9); the % ECL columns (C4, C6, C8, C10) are not used.
